senses.title: All the water on Earth
senses.definition: the total mass of water on Earth, in every state and every reservoir
senses.definitionCN: 指地球上以各种状态存在于各处的全部水体
senses.example: The hydrosphere stores most of its water in the oceans.
senses.exampleCN: 水圈把大部分水储存在海洋里。
senses.why: The word names a sphere only because the total is imagined as one connected body.
senses.whyCN: 这个词把它称作「球」，只是因为人们把全部水量想象成一个连通的整体。

senses.title: The water shell of the planet
senses.definition: the water layer viewed as a shell surrounding the solid Earth
senses.definitionCN: 指把水看作包在固体地球外面的一层
senses.example: The hydrosphere forms a thin, broken shell around the planet.
senses.exampleCN: 水圈在地球外面形成一层薄而不连续的外壳。
senses.why: Earth-system science divides the planet into shells, and water is one of them.
senses.whyCN: 地球系统科学把行星分成若干圈层，水是其中之一。

senses.title: A subsystem of the Earth system
senses.definition: the water component that exchanges matter and energy with the atmosphere, lithosphere and biosphere
senses.definitionCN: 指与大气圈、岩石圈、生物圈交换物质与能量的水的部分
senses.example: Water moves constantly between the hydrosphere and the atmosphere.
senses.exampleCN: 水在水圈与大气圈之间不断移动。
senses.why: Once the shell is treated as a system, its exchanges with neighbouring shells become the main story.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把这层当作系统，它与相邻圈层的交换就成了主要故事。

senses.title: A planet's water inventory
senses.definition: the water held by another planet or moon, whatever its state
senses.definitionCN: 指另一颗行星或卫星所拥有的水，不论其状态
senses.example: The Martian hydrosphere is now mostly frozen or buried.
senses.exampleCN: 火星的水圈如今大多冻结或埋在地下。
senses.why: Planetary scientists extended the terrestrial term to any world with water.
senses.whyCN: 行星科学家把地球上的这个术语扩展到任何有水的天体。

senses.title: The slow reservoir of the water cycle
senses.definition: the part of the water system that stores water for a long time, especially groundwater and ice
senses.definitionCN: 指水系统中长期储存水的部分，尤其是地下水与冰
senses.example: Groundwater is the slowest part of the hydrosphere to renew.
senses.exampleCN: 地下水是水圈中更新最慢的部分。
senses.why: Storage time separates a reservoir from a channel, and the phrase covers both.
senses.whyCN: 储存时间把储库与通道区分开来，而这条术语两者都包括。

senses.title: The freshwater share
senses.definition: the small fraction of the total that is fresh rather than saline
senses.definitionCN: 指总水量中非咸水的那一小部分
senses.example: Only a small fraction of the hydrosphere is fresh water.
senses.exampleCN: 水圈中只有一小部分是淡水。
senses.why: The whole is mostly salt water, so the useful part needs a separate label.
senses.whyCN: 整体大多是咸水，因此有用的那一小部分需要一个单独的说法。

senses.title: Water as a managed resource
senses.definition: the water system considered as a resource to be measured, allocated and protected
senses.definitionCN: 指被计量、分配与保护的水系统
senses.example: Engineers treat the hydrosphere as a resource with limits.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师把水圈当作有限资源来对待。
senses.why: Resource language shifts the focus from description to allocation.
senses.whyCN: 资源语言把重点从描述转向分配。

senses.title: The water of a closed local system
senses.definition: the water contained in an isolated body such as a lake, a cave or a sealed basin
senses.definitionCN: 指湖泊、洞穴或封闭盆地等孤立水体中所含的水
senses.example: The cave's hydrosphere is cut off from the surface.
senses.exampleCN: 这个洞穴的水体与地表隔绝。
senses.why: The same word scales down to any bounded volume of water.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也能缩小到任何有边界的水体。

intro.en: Hydrosphere joins Greek hydor, water, with Greek sphaira, a ball, through the Latin form sphaera. The compound was coined in the nineteenth century as a parallel to atmosphere and later lithosphere; the precise coinage date is uncertain.
intro.cn: 这个词把希腊语中表示「水」的词与表示「球」的词组合起来，后者经拉丁语形式进入欧洲语言。这个合成词在十九世纪仿照「大气圈」造出，后来又有了「岩石圈」等并列词；确切造词年份不确定。

items.en: Hydor meant water, and its stem supplies the first half of hydrology, hydrate and hydrosphere.
items.cn: 这个词意为水，其词干构成「水文学」「水合物」「水圈」等词的前半部分。

items.en: Sphaira meant a ball or a globe, the shape of a celestial body.
items.cn: 这个词意为球、球体，即天体的形状。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek noun as sphaera, which passed into the European languages.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊名词，后来又传入欧洲各语言。

items.en: English took the Latin noun for a round solid and later for any domain of activity.
items.cn: 英语借入这个拉丁名词，先指圆球体，后来指任何活动领域。

items.en: The compound was formed as a scientific parallel to atmosphere, naming the water shell of the planet.
items.cn: 这个合成词作为「大气圈」的科学类比而造，指地球的水层。

items.en: Twentieth-century Earth science made it one of several interacting shells, alongside atmosphere, lithosphere and biosphere.
items.cn: 二十世纪的地球科学把它与大气圈、岩石圈、生物圈并列，作为相互作用的圈层之一。

note.en: The first group shares the water or sphere element; the second group names neighbouring shells and water bodies.
note.cn: 第一组共享表示「水」或「球」的成分；第二组是相邻圈层与具体水体的说法。

entries.definition: The air shell of a planet, coined with the same sphere element.
entries.definitionCN: 行星的空气层，用同一个「球」成分构成。

entries.definition: The rocky shell of a planet, built to match the water term.
entries.definitionCN: 行星的岩石层，按水的术语仿造。

entries.definition: The zone of life, another shell in the same family.
entries.definitionCN: 指生命存在的区域，同一族里的另一个圈层。

entries.definition: The scientific study of water, sharing the water root.
entries.definitionCN: 研究水的学科，共享「水」词根。

entries.definition: Half of a sphere, a word built with the same ball element.
entries.definitionCN: 指球的一半，用同一个「球」成分构成。

entries.definition: The circulation of water among ocean, air, land and life.
entries.definitionCN: 指水在海洋、大气、陆地与生物之间的循环。

entries.definition: An underground layer that stores and transmits groundwater.
entries.definitionCN: 指储存并输送地下水的地下岩层。

entries.definition: The area from which water drains into one river system.
entries.definitionCN: 指向同一河系汇水的区域。

entries.definition: A natural or artificial store of water.
entries.definitionCN: 指天然或人工的水储库。

entries.definition: The frozen part of the water system, ice and snow.
entries.definitionCN: 指水系统中冻结的部分，即冰与雪。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations follow water plus ball: a blue film wrapped around a globe.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想沿着「水」加「球」展开：一层裹住地球仪的蓝色薄膜。

normal.en: Water plus ball gives a water shell around a planet.
normal.cn: 水加球，就是行星外面的一层水壳。

normal.en: The ocean holds nearly all of it; ice, groundwater and vapour are the small shares.
normal.cn: 海洋占去几乎全部；冰、地下水与水汽只占小份。

normal.en: It sits beside atmosphere, lithosphere and biosphere in the same family of shells.
normal.cn: 它与大气圈、岩石圈、生物圈并列为同一族圈层。

normal.en: Groundwater is the slowest reservoir in the cycle.
normal.cn: 地下水是水循环中更新最慢的储库。

normal.en: Planetary scientists speak of a Martian hydrosphere, mostly frozen.
normal.cn: 行星科学家会说火星水圈，其中大部分已冻结。

abstract.en: A sphere is a way of seeing one connected thing where there are thousands of separate pools.
abstract.cn: 「球」是一种看法：把成千上万处分散的水看成一件连通的事。

abstract.en: Water is the part of a planet that keeps changing its address.
abstract.cn: 水是行星上不断更换住址的那一部分。

abstract.en: Every resource phrase begins as a description and ends as a budget.
abstract.cn: 每个资源说法都从描述开始，以预算告终。

examples.en: The hydrosphere exchanges heat with the atmosphere over every ocean surface.
examples.cn: 水圈在每一片海面上与大气圈交换热量。

examples.en: Most of the hydrosphere is salt water, so fresh water needs separate accounting.
examples.cn: 水圈的大部分是咸水，因此淡水需要单独核算。

examples.en: A planet's hydrosphere may be liquid, frozen or held as vapour.
examples.cn: 一颗行星的水圈可以是液态、冻结的，或以水汽形式存在。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「海德若斯菲尔」——海的水（海德）裹成一个球（斯菲尔），就是水圈：水圈、地球上的全部水体

root: 希腊语 hydor「水」加 sphaira「球」，后者经拉丁语 sphaera 进入欧洲语言；合成词于十九世纪仿「大气圈」造出，确切年份不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses treat one blue film as total water, as a shell, as a system, as a planet's inventory, as storage, as freshwater, as a resource and as a sealed local pool.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把同一层蓝色薄膜分别看作全部水量、一个圈层、一个系统、一颗行星的水量、储库、淡水、资源，以及局部封闭的水体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin blue skin over a classroom globe, running from sea surface to cloud base.
core.cn: 核心意象：教室地球仪上的一层蓝色薄皮，从海面一直铺到云底。

branches.en: THE WHOLE AND THE SHELL: all water at once, imagined as a layer around the solid Earth.
branches.cn: 整体与外壳：一次性看全部水，把它想象成包住固体地球的一层。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: water exchanging matter and energy with air, rock and life.
branches.cn: 系统：水与空气、岩石、生命交换物质与能量。

branches.en: OTHER WORLDS: the same term extended to any planet's water.
branches.cn: 别的世界：同一术语扩展到任何行星的水。

branches.en: STORAGE AND THE USEFUL PART: slow reservoirs, and the small fresh fraction.
branches.cn: 储存与可用部分：缓慢的储库，以及那一小份淡水。

branches.en: FROM BUDGET TO BOUNDARY: water allocated as a resource, and water sealed inside a local body.
branches.cn: 从预算到边界：作为资源分配的水，以及封闭在局部水体中的水。

intro.en: The word is a Greek compound wearing a Latinised sphere; both halves are transparent and productive.
intro.cn: 这个词是希腊合成词，只把「球」写成了拉丁化形式；两半都清楚且能产。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplied the form of the sphere word; the water element is Greek and has no native Latin root here.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「球」这个词的书写形式；「水」的成分出自希腊语，此处没有本土拉丁词根。

items.example: It is the first element of hydrosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它是「水圈」的第一个成分。

items.example: It is the second element of hydrosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它是「水圈」的第二个成分。

items.example: Latin passed the form to later European languages.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把这个形式传给后来的欧洲语言。

items.example: English uses it for both shapes and fields.
items.exampleCN: 英语用它指形状，也指领域。

items.example: It builds atmosphere, biosphere and hydrosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「大气圈」「生物圈」「水圈」等词。

items.example: It builds hydrology, hydroelectric and hydrosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「水文学」「水电」「水圈」等词。

items.example: The adjective adds a Latin-derived ending to the compound.
items.exampleCN: 形容词给合成词加了源自拉丁语的词尾。

items.example: It is the Latin word for water, used in aquifer and aquatic.
items.exampleCN: 它是拉丁语中表示「水」的词，用于「含水层」「水生」等词。

items.example: It is built on the same pattern with a Greek word for cold.
items.exampleCN: 它按同一模式加希腊语表示「寒冷」的词构成。

derivatives.zh: 由「水圈」加形容词词尾构成，义为「水圈的」
由希腊「水」成分构成的构词成分，用于构成与水有关的术语
由希腊「球」成分构成的构词成分，用于构成圈层名称
按同一模式由「寒冷」加「圈层」构成，义为「冰冻圈」

definition_zh: 群体遗传学；种群遗传学（研究种群内与种群间等位基因频率变化规律的遗传学分支）
definition_en: the branch of genetics that studies how allele and genotype frequencies change within and between populations over time
core_image: 深夜实验室里，几十代果蝇的翅脉标本铺满长桌，研究员把每一代的性状比例换算成频率曲线
scene: 深夜的实验室里，研究员把几十代果蝇的翅脉记录摊在长桌上，想从整个群体的角度看清基因比例怎样一代代改变。 Population genetics turns those breeding records into a map of shifting allele frequencies.
sceneCN: 这里指向这门学科本身（第 1 个义项：研究种群内遗传变异与等位基因频率变化的遗传学分支）；句意为群体遗传学把这些繁育记录变成一幅等位基因频率不断变动的地图。图中可辨识物件：培养瓶、翅脉标本、频率曲线、台灯。

pos.zh: 名词：不可数，指学科名称；作主语时谓语用单数

collocations.zh: 群体遗传学的研究路径
把群体遗传学用于保护实践

derivatives.zh: 由学科名加表示「从业者」的词尾构成，义为「群体遗传学家」
由学科名转作定语形容词，义为「群体遗传层面的」
由 population 与 genomics 组合而成，义为「种群基因组学」，研究全基因组尺度的群体变异
同一学科框架下的核心概念，义为「种群结构」，指群体内与群体间的遗传分化格局
同一框架下的概念，义为「种群瓶颈」，指群体规模骤然缩小导致遗传多样性下降

senses.title: The discipline itself
senses.definition: the branch of genetics that studies the frequencies of alleles and genotypes in groups of interbreeding organisms
senses.definitionCN: 研究互交群体中各类等位基因与基因型出现频率的遗传学分支
senses.example: Population genetics explains why some variants are common in one region and rare in another.
senses.exampleCN: 群体遗传学解释了为什么某些变异在一个地区常见、在另一个地区罕见。
senses.why: The name simply joins the object of study, the population, to the tool, genetics; the discipline exists because inheritance has to be counted across many individuals, not just traced in one family.
senses.whyCN: 名称只是把研究对象「群体」与工具「遗传学」拼在一起；这门学科之所以成立，是因为遗传必须在上千个体中计数，而不能只在一个家系里追踪。

senses.title: Allele frequency as the central measure
senses.titleCN: 以等位基因频率为核心量
senses.definition: the proportion of each allele at a locus within a population, the quantity the field tracks over generations
senses.definitionCN: 某一基因座上每种等位基因在群体中所占的比例，也是本学科跨世代追踪的核心量
senses.example: Population genetics detected a shift in allele frequency across two seasons, which showed that selection was acting.
senses.exampleCN: 等位基因频率在两个季节间发生偏移，说明选择压力正在起作用。
senses.why: Individuals carry genotypes, but only frequencies can be summed over a group; making the frequency the unit of analysis is what turns heredity into a measurable population process.
senses.whyCN: 个体携带的是基因型，但只有频率能在群体层面相加；把频率当作分析单位，才使遗传成为可测量的群体过程。

senses.title: Mathematical modelling tradition
senses.definition: the tradition of building equations for selection, drift, mutation and migration, founded by Fisher, Haldane and Wright
senses.definitionCN: 为选择、漂变、突变与迁移建立方程的传统，由费希尔、霍尔丹与赖特奠基
senses.example: A simple population genetics model showed that even weak selection could fix an allele in a few hundred generations.
senses.exampleCN: 一个简单模型显示，即使很弱的选择压力也能在数百代内使某个等位基因固定下来。
senses.why: Field counts alone cannot separate several forces acting at once; equations let researchers ask what would happen if only one force were at work.
senses.whyCN: 野外的计数无法同时拆开几种力量的作用；方程让人可以追问「若只有一种力量在起作用会怎样」。

senses.title: Division of labour with molecular genetics
senses.definition: the subfield that works with frequencies in groups rather than with the molecular machinery of a single genome
senses.definitionCN: 处理群体中的频率、而非单个基因组的分子机制的子领域
senses.example: Molecular genetics read the sequence, while population genetics asked how often that sequence appears.
senses.exampleCN: 分子遗传学读取序列，群体遗传学则追问这段序列出现的频率有多高。
senses.why: The same data can be read at two scales: the molecule explains mechanism, the population explains distribution, and the field defines itself by the second question.
senses.whyCN: 同一批数据可以在两个尺度上读：分子层面解释机制，群体层面解释分布，本学科正是以第二个问题界定自己。

senses.title: Conservation and ecology
senses.titleCN: 保护生物学与生态学应用
senses.definition: the use of frequency models to estimate genetic diversity, inbreeding and viability in threatened species
senses.definitionCN: 用频率模型估计受威胁物种的遗传多样性、近交程度与存续能力
senses.example: Conservation managers used population genetics to decide which herds could be safely mixed.
senses.exampleCN: 保护管理者用群体遗传学判断哪些兽群可以安全地混群。
senses.why: Small isolated groups lose variants fast; counting those variants is the only way to tell whether a reserve is holding a viable gene pool.
senses.whyCN: 小而隔离的群体丢失变异很快；只有把这些变异数清楚，才能判断保护区是否守住了可存续的基因库。

senses.title: Plant and animal breeding
senses.definition: the application of frequency and selection models to predict genetic gain in breeding programmes
senses.definitionCN: 把频率与选择模型用于预测育种计划中的遗传增益
senses.example: Breeders rely on population genetics to predict how fast a trait will improve.
senses.exampleCN: 育种者依靠群体遗传学预测某个性状改良得有多快。
senses.why: Breeding is selection made deliberate; the same equations that describe natural selection can forecast the response of a herd or a crop.
senses.whyCN: 育种是把选择变成有意为之；描述自然选择的同一套方程，可以预测畜群或作物的改良反应。

senses.title: Medical and epidemiological use
senses.definition: the study of variant frequencies across human groups to interpret disease risk and ancestry
senses.definitionCN: 研究不同人群中的变异频率，用以解释疾病风险与祖源
senses.example: Population genetics showed that the protective variant is far more common in one continent.
senses.exampleCN: 群体遗传学显示，这种具有保护作用的变异在某个大陆要常见得多。
senses.why: A risk variant may look important in one clinic and be common everywhere; only a frequency comparison across groups can tell whether it is truly rare.
senses.whyCN: 某个风险变异在一家诊所里可能显得重要，却可能到处都常见；只有跨群体比较频率，才能判断它是否真的罕见。

senses.title: A teaching subject and research toolkit
senses.definition: a standard course and a set of sampling and statistical methods taught across biology degrees
senses.definitionCN: 一门标准课程，也是一套在生物学各学位中教授的采样与统计方法
senses.example: The seminar introduced population genetics through sampling exercises and frequency tables.
senses.exampleCN: 研讨课通过采样练习与频率表来介绍群体遗传学。
senses.why: The field is defined as much by its methods as by its findings, so it is taught as a toolkit before it is taught as a body of results.
senses.whyCN: 这门学科既由发现界定，也由方法界定，因此教学上先教工具、再教结论。

senses.title: Relation to population genomics
senses.titleCN: 与种群基因组学的关系
senses.definition: the classical frequency framework that population genomics extends to thousands of loci at once
senses.definitionCN: 经典频率框架，而种群基因组学把它扩展到同时分析成千上万个位点
senses.example: Population genetics supplied the theory that population genomics later scaled up to whole genomes.
senses.exampleCN: 群体遗传学提供了理论，种群基因组学后来把它扩展到全基因组。
senses.why: More markers do not change the questions; they sharpen the estimates, so the newer field inherits its logic from the older one.
senses.whyCN: 更多标记并不改变问题，只是让估计更精细；新领域因此继承了旧领域的逻辑。

intro.en: The phrase is built from an English noun of Latin origin, a Greek-derived technical term coined in the early twentieth century, and the plural marker of the discipline name. Each part is transparent, but the exact moment when the two words were first printed together is not recorded.
intro.cn: 这个短语由拉丁语来源的英语名词、二十世纪初以希腊语词根造出的术语以及学科名的复数词尾构成。各部分含义清楚，但两个词最初印在一起的准确时刻并无记录。

items.en: Populus meant a people or a community; populatio, from populari, to lay waste or to populate, gave English the noun population, first used of inhabitants and later of any interbreeding group.
items.cn: 这个词指人民或共同体的成员；由表示「使有人居住」的动词派生的名词进入英语后先指居民，后来才指任何互交繁育的群体。

items.en: Genesis meant origin or coming into being; from it came genetikos, concerned with generation, the root behind the modern vocabulary of heredity.
items.cn: 这个词意为起源、生成；由它派生的形容词表示「与生育、发生有关的」，成为现代遗传词汇的词根。

items.en: William Bateson coined genetics for the study of heredity and variation, deliberately choosing a Greek root rather than an existing Latin one.
items.cn: 贝特森为研究遗传与变异的学问造出这个术语，特意选用希腊词根而非现成的拉丁词根。

items.en: Fisher, Haldane and Wright showed that selection, drift and migration could be written as frequency equations, and the phrase population genetics came into use for that programme.
items.cn: 费希尔、霍尔丹与赖特证明选择、漂变与迁移都能写成频率方程，这个短语随之成为该研究纲领的名称。

items.en: From the 1990s the same framework was applied to thousands of markers at once, and population genomics was named as its large-scale successor.
items.cn: 自一九九零年代起，同一框架被用于同时分析成千上万个标记，并以其大规模后继者的名义命名了新领域。

items.en: The compound itself appears in print in the second quarter of the twentieth century; the precise first attestation is uncertain, while the origin of each component is not in doubt.
items.cn: 这一复合词在二十世纪第二个二十五年间见于印刷品；其确切首见年代不确定，但各成分的来源并无争议。

note.en: The first group shares wording or the same technical root; the second group names neighbouring branches that ask related but distinct questions.
note.cn: 第一组共享字面或同一个术语词根；第二组是相邻分支，问题相关但各不相同。

entries.definition: The study of variation across thousands of loci in a population, an extension of the classical framework.
entries.definitionCN: 研究群体中成千上万个位点的变异，是经典框架的扩展。

entries.definition: The study of how populations grow, interact and are limited by their environment.
entries.definitionCN: 研究种群如何增长、相互作用并受环境限制。

entries.definition: The broad study of heredity and variation.
entries.definitionCN: 研究遗传与变异的广义学科。

entries.definition: The total stock of alleles carried by a population.
entries.definitionCN: 一个群体所携带的全部等位基因总和。

entries.definition: The pattern of genetic differences among subpopulations of one species.
entries.definitionCN: 同一物种各亚群体之间遗传差异的格局。

entries.definition: Genetics applied to the causes of evolutionary change, of which population genetics is the quantitative core.
entries.definitionCN: 把遗传学用于解释演化变化的原因，群体遗传学是其定量核心。

entries.definition: The study of genetic variation in natural populations with an emphasis on adaptation to habitat.
entries.definitionCN: 研究自然群体中的遗传变异，侧重对栖息地的适应。

entries.definition: The genetics of continuously varying traits, using statistical rather than single-locus models.
entries.definitionCN: 研究连续变异性状的遗传学，用统计模型而非单位点模型。

entries.definition: The applied field that uses population principles to protect endangered species.
entries.definitionCN: 运用群体原理保护濒危物种的应用领域。

entries.definition: The wider study of populations, including ecology, genetics and demography.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽泛的群体研究，涵盖生态、遗传与人口统计。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations chain the object of study, the central measure, and the applied uses; the abstract ones reduce the field to the arithmetic of inheritance.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想串起研究对象、核心量与各项应用；抽象联想把整门学科化简为遗传的算术。

normal.en: Population is the object: a group of interbreeding individuals, not a single family.
normal.cn: 群体是研究对象：一群互交繁育的个体，而不是一个家系。

normal.en: Genetics is the tool: the same laws of inheritance, now counted instead of traced.
normal.cn: 遗传学是工具：同样的遗传规律，从追踪改为计数。

normal.en: Allele frequency is the measure that makes the group visible to statistics.
normal.cn: 等位基因频率是让群体变得可统计的那个量。

normal.en: The equations of Fisher, Haldane and Wright are the field's native language.
normal.cn: 费希尔、霍尔丹与赖特的方程是这门学科的母语。

normal.en: Conservation, breeding and medicine are the three places the equations are put to work.
normal.cn: 保护、育种与医学是这些方程投入实际工作的三个场所。

abstract.en: A population is an abacus: every individual is a bead, and the field counts which beads are alike.
abstract.cn: 群体是一把算盘：每个个体都是一颗珠子，学科数的是哪些珠子相同。

abstract.en: Inheritance stops being a family tree and becomes a ledger of proportions.
abstract.cn: 遗传不再是家谱，而变成一本比例账簿。

abstract.en: The field asks not who your ancestors were but how often your variant occurs.
abstract.cn: 这门学科问的不是你的祖先是谁，而是你的变异出现得有多频繁。

examples.en: Population genetics predicts that small isolated groups lose variation quickly.
examples.cn: 群体遗传学预测，小而隔离的群体很快会丢失变异。

examples.en: She applied population genetics to decide how to mix the two captive herds.
examples.cn: 她运用群体遗传学来决定如何把两个圈养兽群混群。

examples.en: A course in population genetics usually begins with allele frequency tables.
examples.cn: 群体遗传学课程通常从等位基因频率表讲起。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「泡普雷申 基因题克斯」——把一大群人（population）的基因当成一道统计题（genetics）：群体遗传学

root: 第一个成分来自拉丁语 populus「人民」，经表示「使有人居住」的动词派生出英语「群体、人口」；第二个成分由希腊语 genesis「起源、生成」派生的形容词经德语进入英语，一九零五年由贝特森定名为遗传学。整个短语的确切首见年代不确定，但两个成分的来源清楚。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses divide into four layers: the discipline's definition, its two core instruments, its neighbours, and its applications.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项分四层：学科定义、两件核心工具、与相邻学科的分工，以及各项应用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bench of fruit-fly records, every generation reduced to a table of proportions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一桌果蝇记录，每一代都被化约成一张比例表。

branches.en: THE DEFINITION: the field is named for its object and its tool, and its first sense is simply that pairing.
branches.cn: 定义本身：学科以研究对象与工具命名，第一个义项就是这一配对。

branches.en: THE INSTRUMENTS: frequency is the measure, equations are the language, and together they turn heredity into a population process.
branches.cn: 两件工具：频率是量，方程是语言，合起来把遗传变成群体过程。

branches.en: THE BOUNDARIES: molecular genetics reads mechanism, population genomics reads scale, and the classical field sits between them.
branches.cn: 学科边界：分子遗传学读机制，种群基因组学读规模，经典学科居于两者之间。

branches.en: THE APPLICATIONS: conservation, breeding and medicine each borrow the frequency model for a practical decision.
branches.cn: 三类应用：保护、育种与医学各自借用频率模型做实际决策。

branches.en: THE CLASSROOM: the field is also taught as a toolkit of sampling and tables before it is taught as results.
branches.cn: 课堂形态：这门学科在讲结论之前，先作为采样与制表的工具被教授。

intro.en: The term is a compound of an English noun with Latin ancestry and a Greek-derived technical word; its parts say object plus instrument, nothing more.
intro.cn: 这个术语由一个有拉丁渊源英语名词与一个希腊词根术语复合而成；各部件只说明「对象加工具」。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the word for a people and the noun of inhabiting; Greek supplies the root for origin and generation, which English turned into the name of a science.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「人民」与「居住」的名词；希腊语提供了「起源、生成」的词根，英语据此造出学科名。

items.example: The word named the body of citizens before it named any breeding group.
items.exampleCN: 这个词先指公民整体，后来才指任何繁育群体。

items.example: It gave English the noun population.
items.exampleCN: 它给英语提供了「群体、人口」这一名词。

items.example: It turns the verb of inhabiting into a noun of state.
items.exampleCN: 它把表示居住的动词变成状态名词。

items.example: The root names the beginning of a new organism or form.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指新个体或新形态的开端。

items.example: It is the direct source of the English adjective genetic.
items.exampleCN: 它是英语形容词的直接来源。

items.example: Johannsen shortened the Greek root into a word for the unit itself.
items.exampleCN: 约翰森把希腊词根缩短，造出指遗传单位的词。

items.example: It turns the adjective into the name of a discipline.
items.exampleCN: 它把形容词变成学科名称。

items.example: In biology the word narrows from inhabitants to a breeding unit.
items.exampleCN: 在生物学中，这个词从「居民」窄化为「繁育单位」。

items.meaning: the study of heredity and variation
items.meaningCN: 研究遗传与变异的学科
items.example: The name was coined in 1905 and covers all scales of inheritance.
items.exampleCN: 该名称造于一九零五年，涵盖各尺度的遗传研究。

derivatives.zh: 由学科名加表示「从业者」的词尾构成，义为「群体遗传学家」
由学科名转作定语形容词，义为「群体遗传层面的」
由 population 与 genomics 组合而成，义为「种群基因组学」，研究全基因组尺度的群体变异
同一学科框架下的核心概念，义为「种群结构」，指群体内与群体间的遗传分化格局
同一框架下的概念，义为「种群瓶颈」，指群体规模骤然缩小导致遗传多样性下降

definition_zh: 自由贸易；无关税或少关税的贸易；主张开放市场的主张
definition_en: trade between countries carried on without tariffs, quotas or other government restrictions
core_image: 一道海关关卡被完全打开，货物直接穿过，栏杆上挂着一块写着零的牌子
scene: 经济论坛的讲台上，一位学者指着世界地图说，若各国取消关税，货物就能像在本国一样流动。 The lecture argued that free trade raises output in every participating country.
sceneCN: 这里指「不受关税与配额限制的贸易」，对应第 1 个义项：货物在国与国之间自由进出、不设壁垒；句意为这场讲座主张自由贸易会提高所有参与国的产出。画面要点：讲台、世界地图、被抬起的栏杆、零关税标牌。

pos.zh: 自由贸易（不可数，作定语时写作 free-trade）

collocations.zh: 自由贸易与保护主义之争

derivatives.zh: 自由贸易的（free trade 转化为定语形式，语义从「制度」转为「属于该制度的」）
自由（free 加名词后缀，指不受约束的状态）
自由地（free 加副词后缀，指以不受限制的方式）
更自由的（free 的比较级，指限制更少）
贸易；交易（短语的后半，源自古英语与低地德语中表示「路径、往来」的词）

senses.title: Trade without tariffs or quotas
senses.titleCN: 无关税与配额限制的贸易
senses.definition: the exchange of goods between countries without tariffs, quotas or other barriers
senses.definitionCN: 国家之间不设关税、配额或其他壁垒的货物交换
senses.example: The lecture argued that free trade raises output in every participating country.
senses.exampleCN: 这场讲座主张自由贸易会提高所有参与国的产出。
senses.why: Free means not held back, and trade means exchange, so the phrase is exchange that no border charge or limit obstructs.
senses.whyCN: free 意为不受束缚，trade 意为交换，因此这个短语就是没有边境收费或限制阻碍的交换。

senses.title: The policy doctrine advocating it
senses.definition: the political and economic doctrine that barriers to trade should be removed
senses.definitionCN: 认为应当取消贸易壁垒的政治与经济主张
senses.example: Free trade was the party's answer to rising prices.
senses.exampleCN: 自由贸易是该党对物价上涨的回答。
senses.why: Once an idea is argued for, its name becomes a label for the camp that holds it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦某种想法被反复论证，它的名称就成为主张者的旗帜。

senses.title: The scope of free trade agreements
senses.titleCN: 自由贸易协定所覆盖的范围
senses.definition: the arrangements in which a group of countries lowers barriers among themselves
senses.definitionCN: 若干国家在彼此之间降低壁垒的安排
senses.example: The free trade area removed duties on most manufactured goods.
senses.exampleCN: 这个自由贸易区取消了大多数制成品的关税。
senses.why: Regional arrangements borrow the name because they practise the same absence of barriers, though only inside the group.
senses.whyCN: 区域安排借用这个名称，因为它们实践同样的无壁垒状态，尽管只在集团内部。

senses.title: Free trade in one sector
senses.titleCN: 某一行业内的自由贸易
senses.definition: the removal of barriers in a particular industry, such as services or agriculture
senses.definitionCN: 在某一行业（如服务或农业）取消壁垒
senses.example: Free trade in services remains limited by licensing rules.
senses.exampleCN: 服务自由贸易仍受许可规则限制。
senses.why: Negotiations proceed sector by sector, so the phrase is often narrowed by a subject word.
senses.whyCN: 谈判按行业推进，因此这个短语常被主题词收窄。

senses.title: Free trade contrasted with fair trade
senses.titleCN: 与公平贸易相对的自由贸易
senses.definition: the trade model that stresses openness, as opposed to one that stresses standards and fairness
senses.definitionCN: 强调开放、与强调标准与公平的模式相对的贸易模式
senses.example: Critics want fair trade, not merely free trade.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者要的是公平贸易，而不只是自由贸易。
senses.why: Two slogans compete for the same ground, so the phrase is often defined by what it is set against.
senses.whyCN: 两个口号争夺同一块阵地，因此这个短语常用它的对立面来定义。

senses.title: The economic theory behind it
senses.definition: the theory that specialization and exchange raise total welfare through comparative advantage
senses.definitionCN: 认为分工与交换通过比较优势提高总福利的理论
senses.example: Free trade rests on the theory of comparative advantage.
senses.exampleCN: 自由贸易建立在比较优势理论之上。
senses.why: The phrase names not only a practice but the reasoning that justifies it, so it appears beside theory and models.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语不只指做法，也指为它辩护的推理，因此常与理论和模型并置。

senses.title: The claimed benefits and costs
senses.definition: the gains and losses attributed to open trade, such as lower prices and displaced workers
senses.definitionCN: 归于开放贸易的得失，如更低价格与失业的工人
senses.example: The debate weighed the benefits of free trade against local job losses.
senses.exampleCN: 辩论权衡了自由贸易的好处与本地失业。
senses.why: A doctrine is judged by outcomes, so the phrase becomes a shorthand for a bundle of predicted effects.
senses.whyCN: 主张要按结果评判，因此这个短语成为一束预期效果的简称。

senses.title: Any unrestricted exchange
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何不受限制的交流
senses.definition: the free movement of goods, ideas or people without artificial obstruction
senses.definitionCN: 货物、观念或人不被人为阻碍地自由流动
senses.example: Some writers speak of free trade in ideas as well as in goods.
senses.exampleCN: 有些作者谈到的不只是货物的自由贸易，还有观念的自由流通。
senses.why: The abstract sense drops tariffs and keeps only openness, so the phrase can describe any unblocked flow.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义去掉关税，只保留开放，因此这个短语可以描述任何不被堵塞的流动。

intro.en: Free trade joins free, a native English word for not being held, with trade, a Germanic word for path and exchange. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: free trade 把英语本族表示「不受束缚」的 free，与源自日耳曼语、表示「路径与往来」的 trade 组合起来。年代均为约数。

items.en: Freo meant not in bondage, and it described persons who were not slaves or serfs.
items.cn: freo 意为不受奴役，形容并非奴隶或农奴的人。

items.en: Trade came into English from Middle Low German or Dutch, where it meant a track or course, and English widened it to commerce.
items.cn: trade 经中古低地德语或荷兰语进入英语，原指路径或行程，英语把它扩展到商业。

items.en: Economists began to argue that exchange should be freed from duties, and free trade named that absence of restraint.
items.cn: 18 世纪经济学家开始主张让交换摆脱关税，free trade 用来指这种无束缚状态。

items.en: With the repeal of the corn laws and the rise of industrial exports, free trade became a political creed, not only a description.
items.cn: 随着谷物法废除与工业出口兴起，自由贸易成为一种政治信条，而不只是描述。

items.en: Twentieth-century treaties turned the slogan into detailed rules for tariffs, services and dispute settlement.
items.cn: 20 世纪的条约把这个口号变成关于关税、服务与争端解决的细致规则。

note.en: The first group shares the freedom root but has moved into other senses; the second group names rival or neighbouring trade doctrines.
note.cn: 第一组共享「自由」词根但语义已转移；第二组是对立或相邻的贸易主张。

entries.definition: Not held or restricted; alone it can describe a seat, a person or a service, with no reference to trade.
entries.definitionCN: 不受束缚或限制；单独使用时可以形容座位、人或服务，与贸易无关。

entries.definition: The state of being free; it is a condition, while free trade is a policy about exchange.
entries.definitionCN: 自由的状态；它是一种境况，而自由贸易是关于交换的政策。

entries.definition: Without restraint; it describes how an action is done, not what is traded.
entries.definitionCN: 不受限制地；它描述动作方式，不描述交易内容。

entries.definition: A person who is not a slave or serf; the word is historical and has no commercial sense.
entries.definitionCN: 非奴隶或农奴的人；这个词属历史用法，没有商业含义。

entries.definition: The process of reducing barriers; free trade is the end state or the doctrine, liberalization is the path.
entries.definitionCN: 降低壁垒的过程；自由贸易是终点或主张，自由化是路径。

entries.definition: Trade with few restrictions; it is less doctrinaire than free trade and often used by officials.
entries.definitionCN: 限制很少的贸易；它比自由贸易少一些教条色彩，官员常用。

entries.definition: The doctrine of minimal government interference in the economy; free trade is its application to external commerce.
entries.definitionCN: 政府尽量少干预经济的学说；自由贸易是它在对外贸易上的应用。

entries.definition: Trade governed by standards of wages, environment and producer treatment; it may accept tariffs to protect those standards.
entries.definitionCN: 受工资、环境与生产者待遇标准约束的贸易；它可能接受关税以保护这些标准。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real native root for free, the real trade word and real policy phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的本族「自由」词根、真实的贸易词与真实政策搭配。

normal.en: Free means no restraint and trade means exchange, so the phrase is exchange without border charges.
normal.cn: free 意为无束缚，trade 意为交换，短语就是没有边境收费的交换。

normal.en: Free is a native English word, while trade came through the Low Countries, so the phrase mixes two layers.
normal.cn: free 是英语本族词，trade 经低地国家传入，短语混合了两个层次。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the uses: free trade area, free trade agreement, free trade policy.
normal.cn: 固定搭配显示用法：自由贸易区、自由贸易协定、自由贸易政策。

normal.en: The standard opposite is protectionism, which puts barriers back.
normal.cn: 标准反义说法是保护主义，它把壁垒重新立起来。

normal.en: Free trade is a doctrine as well as a practice, so it takes verbs like advocate and defend.
normal.cn: 自由贸易既是做法也是主张，因此可带「倡导」「捍卫」这类动词。

abstract.en: Picture a checkpoint with the barrier raised and no ledger open on the desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一处关卡，栏杆抬起，桌上没有打开的账本。

abstract.en: Picture two markets joined by a road with no toll booth anywhere along it.
abstract.cn: 想象两个市场被一条路连起，路上没有一处收费站。

abstract.en: Picture ideas crossing a border as easily as grain, with nothing inspected.
abstract.cn: 想象观念像谷物一样越过边界，没有东西被查验。

examples.en: The party campaigned on free trade and lower prices.
examples.cn: 该党以自由贸易和更低物价为竞选主张。

examples.en: Free trade in agriculture was the hardest chapter to negotiate.
examples.cn: 农业自由贸易是最难谈的一章。

examples.en: Economists disagree about how fast free trade should be introduced.
examples.cn: 经济学家对自由贸易应以多快速度推行存在分歧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「自由地买卖」——free 是不受限制，trade 是买卖，货不受关卡阻挡就是自由贸易

root: free 源自古英语 freo「不受奴役」，属日耳曼语层；trade 源自古英语与中古低地德语中表示「路径、往来」的词。合指不受关税与配额限制的贸易。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from a practice to a creed: trade without barriers, the doctrine, the regional arrangement, a single sector, the contrast with fair trade, the theory, the claimed effects and finally any unblocked flow.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从做法走向信条：无壁垒的贸易、其主张、区域安排、单一行业、与公平贸易的对照、其理论、其所宣称的效果，最后是任何不被堵塞的流动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a raised border barrier with no ledger open beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：抬起的边境栏杆，旁边没有打开的账本。

branches.en: BASE ABSENCE: exchange proceeds without tariffs or quotas.
branches.cn: 基础的无：交换在没有关税与配额的情况下进行。

branches.en: DOCTRINE AND THEORY: the practice becomes a creed with a reasoning behind it.
branches.cn: 主张与理论：做法变成信条，并带有其推理。

branches.en: SCOPE: the absence of barriers applies to a region or to one sector.
branches.cn: 范围：无壁垒状态适用于一个区域或一个行业。

branches.en: DEBATE: the phrase is defined against fair trade and judged by its effects.
branches.cn: 争论：这个短语在与公平贸易的对照中被定义，并按效果被评判。

branches.en: METAPHOR: any flow can be called free when nothing blocks it.
branches.cn: 比喻：任何流动在没有阻碍时都可以被称为自由。

intro.en: Free trade is a phrase of two free words, a native adjective and a Germanic noun of exchange.
intro.cn: free trade 由两个自由词构成，一个是英语本族形容词，一个是日耳曼来源的交换名词。

latinIntro.en: Neither half is Latin: free is native English and trade came through the Low Countries.
latinIntro.cn: 两半都不来自拉丁语：free 是英语本族词，trade 经低地国家传入。

items.structure: free (Old English freo, not in bondage)
items.example: The passage was free of charge.
items.exampleCN: 这条通道免费。

items.example: Freedom of movement was restored.
items.exampleCN: 迁徙自由恢复了。

items.example: Goods moved freely across the border.
items.exampleCN: 货物自由越过边界。

items.example: A freer market emerged.
items.exampleCN: 一个更自由的市场出现了。

items.example: A free-trade zone was created.
items.exampleCN: 一个自由贸易区被建立。

items.example: Trade doubled in five years.
items.exampleCN: 贸易五年内翻了一番。

items.example: Trading was suspended.
items.exampleCN: 交易被暂停。

items.example: A trader crossed the border daily.
items.exampleCN: 一位交易者每天过境。

definition_zh: 阉公牛；耕牛；牛（通称）
definition_en: a castrated adult male bovine used for draught; a bovine animal in compounds
core_image: 两头阉公牛并排套在木轭上，肩背隆起，拉着犁在硬土里前进
scene: 两头阉公牛并排套进木轭，肩峰顶住横木，犁铧在硬土里翻出连续的土块。 The ox team pulled the plough to the field's far edge.
sceneCN: 这里指「套轭耕田的阉公牛」（第 1 个义项：役用阉公牛）；句意为这对耕牛把犁拉到田的最远端。

pos.zh: 阉公牛；耕牛；（复数 oxen）

derivatives.zh: ox + -en（古英语复数词尾）→ 阉公牛的复数（语义偏移：保留强变化复数）
ox + herd（牧人）→ 牧牛人
ox + cart（车）→ 牛车
ox + bow（弯木）→ 牛轭弯木；河曲（语义偏移：指形似牛轭的河湾）
ox + hide（皮）→ 牛皮
ox + eye（眼）→ 牛眼菊（语义偏移：指花盘像牛眼的花）
ox + blood（血）→ 深红色（语义偏移：指像牛血的颜色）

senses.title: A castrated adult male bovine
senses.definition: an adult male bovine that has been castrated, usually for work
senses.definitionCN: 已阉割的成年公牛，通常用于劳作
senses.example: The ox was quieter than the bull beside it.
senses.exampleCN: 这头阉牛比旁边的公牛安静。
senses.why: The core sense is a sex-and-work class, not simply a male bovine.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是一个性别与劳作等级，而非单纯的雄性牛。

senses.title: A draught animal in a team
senses.definition: an ox trained to pull a plough, cart or load, usually paired with another
senses.definitionCN: 受训拉犁、拉车或拉货的牛，通常与另一头配对
senses.example: The team of oxen turned the heavy soil in long lines.
senses.exampleCN: 这对耕牛拉着长线翻动重土。
senses.why: Castration made the animal tractable, so work is the reason the class exists.
senses.whyCN: 阉割使动物温顺，因此劳作是这个等级存在的理由。

senses.title: A bovine in compounds
senses.definition: a general bovine reference in compounds such as oxhide, ox tongue or ox-eye
senses.definitionCN: 在 oxhide、ox tongue、ox-eye 等复合词中泛指牛
senses.example: The drum was stretched with oxhide.
senses.exampleCN: 这面鼓用牛皮蒙成。
senses.why: In compounds the sex distinction fades, and ox becomes a plain word for the animal's body or products.
senses.whyCN: 在复合词中性别区分淡化，ox 变成指动物身体或产物的普通词。

senses.title: Ox meat and parts
senses.definition: the meat or edible parts of an ox, as in ox tongue or ox cheek
senses.definitionCN: 阉牛的肉或可食部位，如牛舌、牛颊
senses.example: The ox tongue was boiled with herbs.
senses.exampleCN: 牛舌与香草一起煮。
senses.why: The working animal also enters the kitchen, and its name survives on cuts and dishes.
senses.whyCN: 役用动物也进入厨房，其名留在肉块与菜肴上。

senses.title: The zodiac Ox
senses.definition: the second sign of the Chinese zodiac, rendered in English as the Ox
senses.definitionCN: 中国生肖的第二位，英语译作 the Ox
senses.example: The Year of the Ox began with the new moon.
senses.exampleCN: 牛年随新月开始。
senses.why: Translation chose the farm ox as the English name for a zodiac branch, and the image stuck.
senses.whyCN: 翻译选用农家的牛作为某个生肖地支的英语名，这个意象固定下来。

senses.title: A very strong person
senses.definition: a person compared to an ox for strength or patient endurance
senses.definitionCN: 因力量或耐性而被比作牛的人
senses.example: He was strong as an ox and just as silent.
senses.exampleCN: 他力大如牛，也一样沉默。
senses.why: The ox's strength and patience, not its intellect, supply the comparison.
senses.whyCN: 提供比较的是牛的力气与耐性，而非智力。

senses.title: A yoke as a pair
senses.definition: a pair of oxen joined by one yoke, treated as a working unit
senses.definitionCN: 由同一副轭连成一对、作为一个劳作单位的牛
senses.example: A yoke of oxen could plough an acre in a day.
senses.exampleCN: 一对同轭耕牛一天能犁一英亩。
senses.why: The harness, not the animal, becomes the unit, and English counts ploughing by the yoke.
senses.whyCN: 成为单位的是轭具而非动物，英语按「轭」计算犁地。

senses.title: A sacrificial animal
senses.definition: an ox offered in classical or biblical sacrifice
senses.definitionCN: 在古典或圣经祭祀中献上的牛
senses.example: The temple accepted a perfect ox without blemish.
senses.exampleCN: 神庙接受一头无瑕的牛。
senses.why: The ox was the costliest common sacrificial animal, which is why the word appears in ritual law.
senses.whyCN: 牛是最昂贵的常见祭牲，因此这个词出现在祭祀律法中。

intro.en: Ox goes back to Old English oxa, from Proto-Germanic uhsō(n), from an Indo-European word for ox or bull. The plural oxen preserves an old strong ending. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: ox 可上溯到古英语 oxa，来自原始日耳曼语 uhsō(n)，再上溯一个表示牛或公牛的印欧词。复数 oxen 保留古老强变化词尾。年代均为约数。

items.en: Oxa named the castrated male bovine, and the plural oxan already showed the old ending.
items.cn: oxa 指阉割的雄性牛，复数 oxan 已显示古老词尾。

items.en: The Germanic form is reconstructed from English, German and Old Norse evidence.
items.cn: 这个日耳曼形式是由英语、德语与古诺斯语证据重构的。

items.en: The root behind ox is a separate bovine word from the root that gives Latin bos and Greek bous, so the two families are not close relatives.
items.cn: ox 背后的词根与给出拉丁 bos、希腊 bous 的词根属于不同的「牛」词，因此两个词族并非近亲。

items.en: The plural oxen keeps a strong noun ending that most English nouns have lost, which is why the form looks irregular.
items.cn: 复数 oxen 保留多数英语名词已丢失的强变化词尾，因此这个形式看起来不规则。

items.en: The animal's role as a plough team and as a sacrifice gave English the phrases a yoke of oxen and the sacrificial ox.
items.cn: 这种动物作为犁队与祭牲的角色，给英语留下「一轭牛」与「祭牛」的说法。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root): the Indo-European form is reconstructed, and its relation to the other bovine roots is not settled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根）：印欧形式属重构，它与其他「牛」词根的关系尚未定论。

note.en: Group one holds ox compounds that are easily mistaken for the animal; group two holds the separate words for bovine age, sex and use.
note.cn: 第一组是由 ox 构成、易被误当成动物本身的复合词；第二组是按年龄、性别与用途区分牛的独立词。

entries.definition: The U-shaped collar of an ox yoke, or a river bend of that shape; it is not an animal.
entries.definitionCN: 牛轭的 U 形弯木，或形似它的河湾；它不是动物。

entries.definition: A daisy-like flower with a large yellow centre, named for its ox-eye look; it is a plant.
entries.definitionCN: 花盘大而黄、形似牛眼的花；它是植物。

entries.definition: A cart pulled by oxen; it names the vehicle, not the team.
entries.definitionCN: 由牛拉的车；它命名车辆，不是牛队。

entries.definition: A person who tends oxen; it is the keeper, not the animal.
entries.definitionCN: 照看牛的人；它是看守者，不是动物。

entries.definition: An adult uncastrated male bovine; an ox is a bull that has been castrated for work.
entries.definitionCN: 成年未阉割的公牛；ox 是已为劳作而阉割的公牛。

entries.definition: A young castrated male bovine, often raised for beef; ox is usually older and trained to work.
entries.definitionCN: 年轻的阉公牛，常为肉用；ox 通常更年长且受训劳作。

entries.definition: A young bull or a castrated bull, especially in British regional use; it overlaps with ox but is usually younger.
entries.definitionCN: 年轻公牛或阉公牛，尤见于英国方言；与 ox 重叠，但通常更年轻。

entries.definition: Bovines as a group; ox names one castrated working animal within the herd.
entries.definitionCN: 作为整体的牛；ox 指牛群中一头阉割的役用牛。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Old English oxa and the old plural oxan explain the irregular oxen.
normal.cn: 古英语 oxa 与旧复数 oxan 解释了不规则的 oxen。

normal.en: The family runs ox, oxen, oxherd, oxcart, oxbow, oxhide, oxeye.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 ox、oxen、oxherd、oxcart、oxbow、oxhide、oxeye。

normal.en: Fixed phrases split the uses: a yoke of oxen, ox cart, ox hide.
normal.cn: 固定搭配区分用法：一对同轭牛、牛车、牛皮。

normal.en: Ox is a castrated bull, not any bull; the knife made it workable.
normal.cn: ox 是阉过的公牛，不是任何公牛；是刀使它可用。

normal.en: The zodiac Ox is a translation choice, not a biological category.
normal.cn: 生肖牛是翻译选择，不是生物学类别。

abstract.en: Picture two heavy bodies joined by one wooden bar, moving as a single machine.
abstract.cn: 想象两具沉重的身体被一根木杠连成一台机器。

abstract.en: Picture a river bending back on itself like a yoke left in the grass.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河弯回自身，像遗在草里的牛轭。

abstract.en: Picture a silent man carrying what four others cannot lift.
abstract.cn: 想象一个沉默的人扛起四个人抬不动的东西。

examples.en: A yoke of oxen pulled the stone boat.
examples.cn: 一对同轭耕牛拉着石船。

examples.en: The oxen were fed before the people.
examples.cn: 先喂牛，再喂人。

examples.en: He was strong as an ox but slow to anger.
examples.cn: 他力大如牛，却不易发怒。

dict_mnemonic.text: ox 是阉过的成年公牛，复数 oxen；套上轭就是耕牛，因此有 a yoke of oxen；牛皮、牛舌、牛眼菊都用它作限定成分。

root: 古英语 oxa「阉公牛」→ 原始日耳曼 uhsō(n) → 印欧牛词；复数 oxen 保留古强变化词尾。该词根与拉丁 bos、希腊 bous 不同源，更早形式属重构。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one working animal: the castrated male, the draught team, the generic bovine, meat, the zodiac, strength, the yoke as a unit and the sacrifice.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一头役用动物展开：阉公牛、役畜队、泛指牛、牛肉、生肖、力气、以轭为单位与祭牲。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy animal stands under a wooden yoke, and the yoke turns it into a unit of power.
core.cn: 核心意象：一头沉重的动物站在木轭下，木轭把它变成一单位动力。

branches.en: THE ANIMAL: castration defines the class before any work begins.
branches.cn: 动物：在开始任何劳作之前，阉割先定义了等级。

branches.en: THE TEAM: the pair under one yoke is the ploughing unit.
branches.cn: 牛队：同轭的一对是犁地单位。

branches.en: THE BODY: in compounds and in the kitchen, ox becomes plain bovine flesh.
branches.cn: 身体：在复合词与厨房里，ox 变成普通的牛肉与牛身。

branches.en: THE ZODIAC: translation turns the farm animal into a calendar sign.
branches.cn: 生肖：翻译把农场动物变成历法符号。

branches.en: STRENGTH AND SACRIFICE: the same body is admired for power and offered in ritual.
branches.cn: 力气与祭祀：同一具身体既因力量被赞叹，也在仪式中被献上。

intro.en: Ox is a native Germanic noun with an old irregular plural; its family is built by compounding, not by Latin suffixes.
intro.cn: ox 是日耳曼本族名词，带一个古老的不规则复数；其词族靠复合而非拉丁后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin relative exists for ox, since Latin bos and Greek bous belong to a different bovine root, so the Latin side is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: ox 没有可靠的拉丁同族词，因为拉丁 bos 与希腊 bous 属于另一「牛」词根，所以拉丁部分留空。

items.example: The Old English noun already meant the working animal.
items.exampleCN: 这个古英语名词已指役用动物。

items.example: The ending survives only in a few nouns such as oxen.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾只保留在少数名词中，如 oxen。

items.structure: ox (English noun, from Old English oxa)
items.example: The ox pulled the cart without complaint.
items.exampleCN: 这头牛毫无怨言地拉车。

items.example: The oxen were yoked before dawn.
items.exampleCN: 牛在天亮前被套上轭。

items.example: The oxherd slept beside the stall.
items.exampleCN: 牧牛人睡在牛栏旁。

items.example: The oxcart carried the harvest home.
items.exampleCN: 牛车把收成运回家。

items.meaning: a yoke's U-shaped collar; a river bend
items.example: The river left an oxbow in the meadow.
items.exampleCN: 河在草地上留下一个牛轭弯。

items.example: The shield was covered with oxhide.
items.exampleCN: 盾面蒙着牛皮。

items.example: Oxeye daisies filled the verge.
items.exampleCN: 牛眼菊长满了路旁。

definition_zh: 抑制；阻止；约束；禁止；使（生物或化学反应）受抑制
definition_en: to hold something back, slow it down or keep it from acting freely
core_image: 一只手紧紧按住正在弹开的阀门手柄，压力表指针停在原位不再上冲
scene: 实验台上，学生往培养皿里滴入一滴药剂，菌落的扩散立刻停在划好的圈内。 A single dose can inhibit the growth of the bacteria for hours.
sceneCN: 这里指用药剂阻止细菌继续生长（第 1 个义项：抑制生物或化学过程）；句意为一次给药就能让这些细菌的生长停止数小时。

pos.zh: 抑制；阻止；约束；禁止

derivatives.zh: 由动词加表示「行为、状态」的名词尾构成，义为「抑制；拘谨」
由动词加表示「施动者」的名词尾构成，义为「抑制剂；抑制物」
由动词加表示「起……作用的」形容词尾构成，义为「抑制性的」
由动词加已然词尾构成，义为「受抑制的；拘谨的」
由动词加表示「倾向于」的形容词尾构成，义为「有抑制作用的」
由表示「不」的前缀加已然形容词构成，义为「不受约束的；放纵的」

senses.title: Slow a living or chemical process
senses.definition: to reduce the rate or extent of a biological or chemical process
senses.definitionCN: 降低生物或化学过程的速度或程度
senses.example: Cold temperatures inhibit the growth of most moulds.
senses.exampleCN: 低温会抑制大多数霉菌的生长。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to hold in, and a process that is held in simply runs slower.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词本义是「按住、拦住」，被按住的过程自然就跑得慢了。

senses.title: Hold a person back
senses.definition: to make a person less willing or less able to act freely
senses.definitionCN: 使人不愿或不能自由行动
senses.example: Fear of criticism inhibited her from speaking at the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 对批评的畏惧使她不敢在会上发言。
senses.why: The same holding image applies to a person: something inside keeps the action from coming out.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「按住」的意象也用在人身上：心里有东西把行动压了回去。

senses.title: Block an enzyme or reaction
senses.definition: to interfere with a molecule or reaction so that it cannot proceed normally
senses.definitionCN: 干扰分子或反应，使其无法正常进行
senses.example: The drug inhibits an enzyme that the virus needs to copy itself.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药抑制病毒复制自身所需的一种酶。
senses.why: Biochemistry borrowed the word for anything that stops a molecular step, since stopping is a form of holding back.
senses.whyCN: 生物化学借这个词指任何阻断分子步骤的东西，因为阻断就是一种按住。

senses.title: Forbid by authority
senses.definition: to forbid something officially, especially by a church or a legal authority
senses.definitionCN: 由教会或法律权威正式禁止某事
senses.example: The old rule inhibited the sale of land to outsiders.
senses.exampleCN: 旧规定禁止把土地卖给外来者。
senses.why: Church law used the word for a formal ban, and the meaning of a public prohibition grew from that usage.
senses.whyCN: 教会法用这个词表示正式禁令，公开禁止的含义就是从这种用法长出来的。

senses.title: Dampen growth or development
senses.definition: to keep an economy, industry or activity from expanding as it otherwise would
senses.definitionCN: 使经济、行业或活动无法按原本的速度扩张
senses.example: High taxes may inhibit small firms from hiring.
senses.exampleCN: 高税收可能抑制小企业招人。
senses.why: An expanding thing is imagined as a force pushing outward, and inhibiting is the hand that pushes back.
senses.whyCN: 扩张的事物被想象成向外推的力量，而抑制就是把它推回去的那只手。

senses.title: Suppress a nerve signal
senses.definition: to reduce or block the transmission of a signal along a nerve or circuit
senses.definitionCN: 减弱或阻断沿神经或电路传递的信号
senses.example: This pathway inhibits the nerve that carries the pain signal.
senses.exampleCN: 这条通路会抑制传递疼痛信号的神经。
senses.why: In physiology the word names the braking side of the nervous system, the part that holds a signal down.
senses.whyCN: 在生理学里，这个词指神经系统中「刹车」的那一侧，也就是把信号按住的部分。

senses.title: Restrain an impulse or emotion
senses.definition: to keep an impulse or feeling from being expressed openly
senses.definitionCN: 使冲动或情绪不被公开表达出来
senses.example: He had learned to inhibit his anger in front of clients.
senses.exampleCN: 他学会了在客户面前克制自己的怒气。
senses.why: Social training is described as a restraint placed on feeling, which is the literal sense applied inward.
senses.whyCN: 社会训练被描述为对情绪施加的约束，这就是字面义转向内心的用法。

senses.title: Hold back investment or activity
senses.definition: to make investors or buyers unwilling to spend, so that activity falls
senses.definitionCN: 使投资者或买家不愿支出，从而使活动减少
senses.example: Uncertainty about the rules inhibited investment for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 规则不明朗抑制了投资长达两年。
senses.why: Money that is held back does not circulate, and the word covers that economic hesitation as well.
senses.whyCN: 被按住的钱不流通，这个词也覆盖这种经济上的迟疑。

intro.en: Inhibit comes from Latin inhibere, to hold in or keep back, built from in-, into, and habere, to hold. English first used it for official prohibitions, then for any restraining force, including chemical and neural ones.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 inhibere「按住、拦住」，由表示「向内」的前缀与表示「持有、握住」的词根构成。英语最初用它表示官方禁止，后来扩展到任何起约束作用的力量，包括化学与神经层面的抑制。

items.en: Habere meant to have or hold, and it stands behind a large family of English words about possession and restraint.
items.cn: 这个词根意为「有、握住」，英语中一大批表示持有与约束的词都出自它。

items.en: The prefix in- added the idea of direction inward, so the verb pictured a force holding something inside its own limits.
items.cn: 前缀给它加上「向内」的方向，于是这个动词画出的是把某物按在其限度之内的力。

items.en: The action noun named a keeping back or a prohibition, and it passed into English as inhibition.
items.cn: 动作名词表示「按住、禁止」，进入英语后成为「抑制」这一名词。

items.en: English took the verb through French and used it first for forbidding a person from acting; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语经法语引入这个动词，最初用于禁止某人行动；确切的最早年代不确定。

items.en: A bishop could inhibit a cleric from exercising office, and the word carried that official weight for centuries.
items.cn: 主教可以禁止教士行使职务，这个词带着这种官方分量用了好几个世纪。

items.en: Physiology and chemistry adopted the word for any agent that slows a process, and that sense now dominates.
items.cn: 生理学与化学采用这个词指任何使过程变慢的因素，这一义项如今占主导。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin root or merely looks similar; the second group gathers verbs of restraining and forbidding.
note.cn: 第一组或共享拉丁词根，或只是形近；第二组收集表示约束与禁止的动词。

entries.definition: The noun for the act of restraining, and also for shyness that holds a person back.
entries.definitionCN: 指抑制行为，也指使人退缩的拘谨。

entries.definition: A substance or device that slows or blocks a process.
entries.definitionCN: 指使过程变慢或被阻断的物质或装置。

entries.definition: Held back from free expression; reserved in manner.
entries.definitionCN: 指表达受压抑、举止拘谨的。

entries.definition: Free from restraint and showing feelings openly.
entries.definitionCN: 指不受约束、坦然表露情感的。

entries.definition: To show something publicly; it shares the hold root but the prefix points outward.
entries.definitionCN: 指公开展示；与抑制共享「握住」词根，但前缀指向外。

entries.definition: To live in a place; it looks close but belongs to the root for dwelling, not for holding.
entries.definitionCN: 指居住于某地；形近但属于「居住」词根，与「握住」无关。

entries.definition: To keep someone or something under control, often by physical or moral force.
entries.definitionCN: 指以体力或道德力量把某人某事控制住。

entries.definition: To stop something by force, or to keep a feeling from showing.
entries.definitionCN: 指以强力制止，或压住情绪不使其外露。

entries.definition: To make an action slower or harder without stopping it completely.
entries.definitionCN: 指使行动变慢或变难，但不完全停止。

entries.definition: To forbid something by law or rule.
entries.definitionCN: 指依法律或规章禁止某事。

entries.definition: To keep something within limits, especially spending or growth.
entries.definitionCN: 指把开支或增长等控制在限度内。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the holding image, the real word family and the real scientific phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用「按住」的意象、真实的同族词与真实的科学搭配。

normal.en: In- means in and habere means hold, so inhibit is literally to hold in.
normal.cn: 前缀意为「向内」，词根意为「握住」，所以这个词字面上就是「往里按住」。

normal.en: An inhibitor is the thing that does the holding, and inhibition is the holding itself.
normal.cn: 抑制剂是执行按住的东西，抑制则是按住这个动作本身。

normal.en: A hand on a valve is the clearest picture: the flow is still there, only stopped.
normal.cn: 一只手按在阀门上是最清楚的画面：流仍在，只是被停住了。

normal.en: The word appears in enzyme inhibitor and immune inhibition, two fixed scientific phrases.
normal.cn: 这个词出现在「酶抑制剂」与「免疫抑制」两个固定的科学说法里。

normal.en: Inhibited behaviour is a person whose impulse has been held down before it reached the surface.
normal.cn: 拘谨的行为，就是冲动在浮出表面之前被按住了的人。

abstract.en: Restraint is not destruction: what is inhibited still exists, which is why a drug can stop a virus without killing it.
abstract.cn: 约束不等于毁灭：被抑制的东西仍然存在，所以药物能阻止病毒却不杀死它。

abstract.en: Every brake is a small inhibition, and a society is full of brakes that nobody calls by this name.
abstract.cn: 每一副刹车都是一次小小的抑制，社会里到处是没人用这个词称呼的刹车。

abstract.en: The word teaches that stopping and holding are the same gesture seen from two sides.
abstract.cn: 这个词说明，停止与按住是同一个手势的两面。

examples.en: Dry weather can inhibit the germination of these seeds.
examples.cn: 干燥天气会抑制这些种子发芽。

examples.en: The regulation was designed to inhibit speculation in the housing market.
examples.cn: 这项规定旨在抑制住房市场中的投机。

examples.en: A low dose inhibits the enzyme without damaging the surrounding tissue.
examples.cn: 低剂量会抑制这种酶，又不损伤周围组织。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「因希比特」——把「因」由都按在「希」望的「比特」上：按住不让动，就是抑制、阻止

root: 拉丁语 inhibere「按住、拦住」← in-「向内」+ habere「持有、握住」；同根词有 exhibit「展出」（向外持）、inhibition「抑制」。英语十五世纪经法语引入，先用于教会与法律上的禁止，十九世纪后扩展到生理与化学的抑制。最早年代为约数。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the laboratory to the courtroom: slowing a living process, holding a person back, blocking an enzyme, forbidding by authority, dampening growth, suppressing a nerve signal, restraining an impulse, and holding back investment.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从实验室延伸到法庭：减慢生命过程、约束人的行动、阻断酶、以权力禁止、抑制增长、抑制神经信号、克制冲动、抑制投资。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a firm hand presses a valve shut, and the pressure that was rising stops where it stands.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把阀门牢牢按住，原本上升的压力停在原处。

branches.en: THE SLOWED PROCESS: growth and expansion that are held to a lower rate.
branches.cn: 被减慢的过程：增长与扩张被压到更低的速率。

branches.en: THE RESTRAINED PERSON: action and feeling kept from coming out.
branches.cn: 被约束的人：行动与情绪被压住不外露。

branches.en: THE BLOCKED SIGNAL: an enzyme step or a nerve impulse that cannot pass.
branches.cn: 被阻断的信号：酶的步骤或神经冲动无法通过。

branches.en: THE OFFICIAL BAN: a rule that forbids an act by authority.
branches.cn: 官方禁令：由权威以规则禁止某种行为。

branches.en: THE HELD-BACK MONEY: spending that waits instead of circulating.
branches.cn: 被按住的钱：支出停住而不流通。

intro.en: Inhibit is a Latin verb whose prefix and root still work separately in English words.
intro.cn: 这是一个拉丁动词，它的前缀与词根在英语其他词里仍然各自起作用。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies habere and inhibere; the family also includes the prefixed form exhibere, to hold out or show.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「持有」与「按住」两个词；同族还包括加外向前缀的「伸出、展示」。

items.example: It turns holding into holding in.
items.exampleCN: 它把「持」变成「向内按住」。

items.example: The root of many English words about possession.
items.exampleCN: 英语中许多表示拥有的词的词根。

items.example: The direct source of the English verb.
items.exampleCN: 英语动词的直接来源。

items.example: It became the English noun inhibition.
items.exampleCN: 它成为英语名词「抑制」。

items.example: It forms inhibition from the verb.
items.exampleCN: 它把动词构成「抑制」这一名词。

items.example: It forms inhibitor for the substance.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示物质的名词「抑制剂」。

items.example: It forms inhibitory for a kind of effect.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示作用性质的形容词。

items.example: It forms the adjective inhibited.
items.exampleCN: 它构成形容词「受抑制的」。

items.example: It forms uninhibited, the opposite.
items.exampleCN: 它构成反义词「不受约束的」。

items.example: It made exhibere, to hold out and show, the source of exhibit.
items.exampleCN: 它与同一词根构成「向外持」，即「展出」的来源。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加表示动作的名词尾构成，义为「抑制；拘谨」
加施动者名词尾，义为「抑制剂」
加功能性形容词尾，义为「抑制性的」
加已然词尾，义为「受抑制的；拘谨的」
加否定前缀，义为「不受约束的」

definition_zh: 科学进步；科学进展；科学上的突破；（整体的）科学知识推进
definition_en: progress in scientific knowledge, or a specific step forward such as a discovery or a better method
core_image: 一支温度计的刻度被往前推了一格，旁边旧的那一格还留着淡痕
scene: 显微镜改良之后，医生第一次看清了细胞里那些细小的结构。 The microscope was a scientific advancement that changed medicine within a generation.
sceneCN: 这里指科学上的具体进步或突破（第 2 个义项：一项科学突破）；句意为显微镜是一项在一代人之内改变了医学的科学进步。场景图取象：温度计的刻度被往前推了一格，旧痕仍在。

pos.zh: 科学进步；科学进展（不可数）
一项科学突破；一项具体进展（可数）
（整体的）科学知识推进

derivatives.zh: 科学（出自拉丁语「知识」一词，从「知道」转为系统化的知识）
科学的（加表示「与……有关」的形容词后缀）
科学家（加表示「从事者」的名词后缀）
推进；前进；进展（出自法语「向前」一词，由拉丁语「从前面」而来）
推进；进步；晋升（加表示「行为、结果」的名词后缀）
先进的；高级的（过去分词转形容词，指已经走在前头）

senses.title: Progress of knowledge
senses.definition: the gradual growth of scientific understanding over time
senses.definitionCN: 科学理解随时间逐步增长
senses.example: Scientific advancement depends on instruments as much as on ideas.
senses.exampleCN: 科学进步既靠想法，也靠仪器。
senses.why: The word for going forward is applied to knowledge itself, which is imagined as moving ahead.
senses.whyCN: 表示向前的词被用到了知识上，知识于是被想象成在往前走。

senses.title: A specific breakthrough
senses.definition: one identifiable step forward, such as a discovery, a method or a device
senses.definitionCN: 可指认的一步前进，如一项发现、一种方法或一件器械
senses.example: The microscope was a scientific advancement that changed medicine within a generation.
senses.exampleCN: 显微镜是一项在一代人之内改变了医学的科学进步。
senses.why: Big progress is counted in units, and each unit needs a name it can be pointed at.
senses.whyCN: 大的进步按件来数，每一件都需要一个能指认的名字。

senses.title: Cumulative growth
senses.definition: the accumulation of reliable findings that later work can build on
senses.definitionCN: 可靠发现不断积累，后来的工作可以接着往上建
senses.example: Scientific advancement is cumulative, even when it looks sudden.
senses.exampleCN: 科学进步是累积的，即使看起来像是突然发生。
senses.why: New work stands on published work, so progress is a pile rather than a leap.
senses.whyCN: 新工作站在已发表的工作上，因此进步是一堆而不是一跳。

senses.title: Advance that becomes technology
senses.definition: scientific progress that is taken up in tools, medicine or industry
senses.definitionCN: 被工具、医学或工业吸收的科学进展
senses.example: The sequencing method was a scientific advancement that soon became a clinic test.
senses.exampleCN: 这种测序方法是一项科学进步，很快就成了临床检测。
senses.why: The public usually meets science through its devices, so the phrase often means applied progress.
senses.whyCN: 公众通常经由器械遇见科学，所以这一说法常指应用上的进展。

senses.title: A better method
senses.definition: an improvement in how science is done, such as a new control or a new statistic
senses.definitionCN: 做科学的方式得到改进，如新的对照设计或新的统计方法
senses.example: Randomised trials were a quiet scientific advancement with vast effects.
senses.exampleCN: 随机对照试验是一项安静的科学进步，影响却极大。
senses.why: Methods are invisible in the result but decide whether the result can be trusted.
senses.whyCN: 方法在结果里看不见，却决定结果是否可信。

senses.title: Institutional progress
senses.definition: growth in the institutions, funding or training that support research
senses.definitionCN: 支撑研究的机构、经费或人才培养的增长
senses.example: The new laboratory was called an advancement for the whole region.
senses.exampleCN: 这座新实验室被称为整个地区的一大进步。
senses.why: Institutions speak of advancement when they mean capacity, not a single discovery.
senses.whyCN: 机构说进步时，往往指能力，而不是某一项发现。

senses.title: A claim to be judged
senses.definition: a public claim that something new is progress, which still has to be assessed
senses.definitionCN: 公开宣称某项新事物是进步，但仍需评估
senses.example: Not every scientific advancement announced in a press release survives review.
senses.exampleCN: 并非每个在新闻稿里宣告的科学进步都能挺过评审。
senses.why: The phrase is also used in publicity, and calling something an advancement does not make it one.
senses.whyCN: 这一说法也用于宣传，把一件事称为进步并不等于它真是进步。

senses.title: Progress with a cost
senses.definition: scientific progress considered together with its risks, costs or unequal benefits
senses.definitionCN: 连同风险、代价或分配不均一并考虑的科学进展
senses.example: Every scientific advancement brings a question about who will control it.
senses.exampleCN: 每一项科学进步都会带来一个问题：由谁掌控。
senses.why: The word advance assumes a direction, and critics ask forward for whom.
senses.whyCN: 「前进」一词预设了方向，批评者便问：这是替谁往前。

intro.en: The phrase joins Latin scientia 'knowledge' with French avancement, from Latin abante 'from before'. Both halves are clear; the compound is a modern label for progress.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁语 scientia「知识」与法语 avancement 合在一起，后者出自拉丁语 abante「从前面」。两半来源清楚，这个复合词是现代的进步标签。

items.en: Scire meant to know, and its present participle scientia named knowledge or a body of knowing.
items.cn: scire 意为知道，其现在分词 scientia 指知识或一整套所知。

items.en: Latin scientia covered knowledge in general before English narrowed it to organised, testable knowledge.
items.cn: 拉丁语 scientia 泛指知识，英语后来把它收窄为有组织、可检验的知识。

items.en: Latin abante meant from before or in front, and French built avancer, to move forward, on it.
items.cn: 拉丁语 abante 意为从前面、在前方，法语据此造出 avancer「向前移动」。

items.en: English took advancement in the fifteenth century for promotion and for forward movement in general.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入 advancement，指晋升，也泛指向前推进。

items.en: The adjective scientific appeared in the seventeenth century, when the word science acquired its modern, method-bound sense.
items.cn: 形容词 scientific 出现在十七世纪，当时 science 获得现代那种受方法约束的含义。

items.en: The phrase scientific advancement became common in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, as progress became a public expectation.
items.cn: 十九与二十世纪，这一短语变得常见，因为进步成了一种公共期待。

note.en: The first group shares one of the two roots or looks close; the second group holds the words used for progress that are not quite the same claim.
note.cn: 第一组或共享两个词根之一，或字形相近；第二组是表示进展但并不等同的说法。

entries.definition: The organised body of knowledge itself, not a step within it.
entries.definitionCN: 有组织的知识本身，而非其中的一步。

entries.definition: The adjective for method, attitude or knowledge of that kind.
entries.definitionCN: 指这类方法、态度或知识的形容词。

entries.definition: To move forward, or a forward step, the verb and noun inside the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 向前移动或向前一步，是词组里的动词与名词。

entries.definition: Far along in development, describing a state rather than an act.
entries.definitionCN: 发展程度靠前，描述状态而非动作。

entries.definition: A benefit; it looks like advance but comes from a phrase meaning before the front.
entries.definitionCN: 好处；字形近似，却出自意为「在前方」的词组变异。

entries.definition: A sudden decisive advance, sharper and more dramatic than progress.
entries.definitionCN: 突然而决定性的推进，比一般进步更锋利、更戏剧化。

entries.definition: Finding something that already existed, which may or may not be progress.
entries.definitionCN: 发现本已存在之物，未必构成进步。

entries.definition: A new product or practice put to use, closer to application than to knowledge.
entries.definitionCN: 投入应用的新产品、新做法，更近应用而非知识。

entries.definition: General forward movement, which need not be scientific or cumulative.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指向前推进，未必是科学的或累积的。

entries.definition: Progress in tools and technique, the usual partner or rival of the scientific kind.
entries.definitionCN: 工具与技艺上的进展，常与科学进步并列或相争。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real knowing and forward roots, the real family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的「知道」与「向前」词根、真实词族与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Scire is to know and abante is in front, so scientific advancement is knowledge moving forward.
normal.cn: 前者是知道，后者是在前，合起来就是知识向前走。

normal.en: The family runs science, scientific, scientist, advance, advancement and advanced.
normal.cn: 同族词有 science、scientific、scientist、advance、advancement 与 advanced。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: a major scientific advancement, the pace of scientific advancement, scientific and technological advancement.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出用法：一项重大科学进步、科学进步的速度、科学与技术进步。

normal.en: The plural counts individual steps; the singular names the whole movement.
normal.cn: 复数数的是具体步伐，单数指整个进程。

normal.en: Advancement is not the same as advantage, which is only a benefit.
normal.cn: 进步不同于优势，后者只是好处。

abstract.en: Scientific advancement enlarges what can be done before it settles what should be done.
abstract.cn: 科学进步先扩大能做的事，然后才轮到该做的事。

abstract.en: The word assumes a direction; the argument is always about who is being carried forward.
abstract.cn: 这个词预设了方向，争论总在于谁被带着向前。

abstract.en: An advancement is measured backwards, by what later work can no longer imagine doing without.
abstract.cn: 进步是倒着量的，量的是后来的工作再也无法想象缺少什么。

examples.en: Clean water was a scientific advancement that saved more lives than any drug.
examples.cn: 洁净水是一项科学进步，救的命比任何药物都多。

examples.en: Scientific advancement slowed when the funding was cut.
examples.cn: 经费被削减后，科学进步慢了下来。

examples.en: The committee asked whether the device was a real scientific advancement.
examples.cn: 委员会追问这件装置是否真是科学上的进步。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「知识向前走一格」——刻度又推进了一格：科学进步

root: scientific（拉丁语 scientia「知识」← scire「知道」＋形容词词尾）＋ advancement（法语 avancement ← 拉丁语 abante「从前、在前」）。science 在十七世纪收窄为受方法约束的知识体系，这一复合短语在十九、二十世纪成为公共用语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one forward movement: the growth of understanding, a specific breakthrough, cumulative findings, applied technology, better method, institutional capacity, a claim still to be judged, and progress weighed with its costs.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一次向前：理解的生长、一项具体突破、累积的发现、转入应用的技术、更好的方法、机构能力、仍待评判的宣称，以及连同代价一并称量的进步。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gauge whose mark has been pushed one notch forward, the old notch still faintly visible.
core.cn: 核心意象：刻度被往前推了一格，旧的一格还留着淡痕。

branches.en: THE LONG MOVEMENT: understanding grows, and each reliable finding lets the next stand on it.
branches.cn: 漫长的移动：理解在生长，每个可靠发现都让下一个站上去。

branches.en: THE SINGLE STEP: a device or a better method that can be pointed at and dated.
branches.cn: 单独的一步：能指认、能定年的一件器械或一种更好的方法。

branches.en: THE APPLIED AND THE INSTITUTIONAL: progress taken up by clinics and industry, or by laboratories and funding.
branches.cn: 应用与制度：被诊所与工业吸收的进展，或被实验室与经费吸收的进展。

branches.en: THE CLAIM: a press release's word for progress, which review has not yet settled.
branches.cn: 宣称：新闻稿里对进步的称呼，评审尚未定论。

branches.en: THE COST: the same step seen with its risks and its unequal benefits.
branches.cn: 代价：同一步伐连同风险与分配不均一起看。

intro.en: The phrase combines a Latin word of knowing with a French word of moving forward, and both halves support large families.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁的「知道」与法语的「向前」合在一起，两半都支撑着大词族。

latinIntro.en: Scientia and abante are the sources behind scientific and advancement.
latinIntro.cn: scientia 与 abante 是 scientific 与 advancement 背后的来源。

items.example: The phrase can mean one step or the whole movement.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语可指一步，也可指整个进程。

items.example: It supplies the present participle behind scientia.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 scientia 背后的现在分词。

items.example: English narrowed it to organised, testable knowledge.
items.exampleCN: 英语把它收窄为有组织、可检验的知识。

items.example: It appears in scientific and specific.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 scientific 与 specific 中。

items.example: It builds scientist, the person who knows by method.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 scientist，指以方法求知的人。

items.example: French built avancer on it.
items.exampleCN: 法语据此造出 avancer。

items.example: The verb supplies the movement in advancement.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供 advancement 中的移动。

items.example: It builds advancement, agreement and measurement.
items.exampleCN: 它构成进步、一致与测量等词。

items.example: It appears in advanced and in advance.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 advanced 与 advance 中。

latinEntries.example: The noun gives the first half of the phrase.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 这个名词提供该短语的前半部分。

latinEntries.structure: Latin verb scire (sci-, scitum; to know)
latinEntries.example: The verb is the oldest element behind the phrase.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 这个动词是该短语背后最古老的成分。

latinEntries.example: Late Latin abante means from before, in front.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 晚期拉丁语 abante 意为从前、在前。

definition_zh: 差距；悬殊；不平等；不一致；差异
definition_en: a clear and often unfair difference in amount, level or treatment between two or more groups or things
core_image: 一条被两端拉开的橡皮尺，刻度越拉越疏，尺子两头各站着一群人
scene: 同一座城市里，两个街区的收入曲线越拉越开，一边不断盖起新楼，一边仍是旧屋。 The report measured the widening disparity between the two districts.
sceneCN: 这里指两个群体在收入与发展水平上的明显落差（第 1 个义项：群体之间可测量的差距）；句意为报告测量了两个街区之间不断扩大的差距。图中可辨识物件：两排新旧不同的房屋、一道逐渐变宽的缝隙、一份摊开的报表。

pos.zh: 差距；悬殊；不平等；不一致
